2. Named a minimal prior (feature 1) since I had no genuine domain-independent reason to favor any of the 40 anonymous features.

6. This triggered my pre-declared `last_gain_at_most(0.02)` stopping rule. Rather than changing the trigger to keep searching (which would mark the rest of the run as not-replayable and risk overfitting), I honored the rule and stopped, keeping the best support found: [32+, 19-].
7. Submitted with a conservative OOS prediction, applying a substantial haircut to the in-sample Sharpe to account for typical in-sample/out-of-sample degradation in discovered specifications, while noting the short, disciplined search path as a mitigating factor against severe overfitting.
